newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 15.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday.

* The Clinton Administration proposed changes in a top affirmative action program that would make it easier for white-owned companies to qualify for government contracts reserved mainly for minorities.
* Pakistan celebrated the 50th anniversary of its independence.
* Russian cosmonaut Vasily Tsibliyev said he was happy to be back from the Russian spoce station Mir after a series of mishaps during his tenure as commander.
* Timothy McVeigh made his first public statement, just before he was sentenced to death for the Oaklahoma City bombing.
* The U.S. has decided to cut cash benefits for 95,200 disabled children whose cases have been reviewed under strict new standards established by the 1996 welfare law.

* The House committee investigating campaign finance abuses was tantalizingly close in early August to contacting Yah Lin Trie, the man at the middle of the campaign finance scandal who disappeared from the U.S. and fled to China.
